findings.problem: In a unit about the people you love, the hint 'informal' only rules out Sie, so 'Ich hab dich lieb.' (the usual way to say I love you to family and friends) would also be a correct answer.

back.target: I love you (said to one person you call du).
back.example: I love you and I miss you.

note: You could add a separate phrase card for 'Ich hab dich lieb.' (for family and friends), since it fits this unit and is how Germans say I love you to people who aren't their partner.
